      "path": "routers/group_001.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom database import SessionLocal\nfrom models import VolunteerShift, DonationAllocation\nfrom schemas import CancelVolunteerShiftResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"VolunteerShifts\"])\n\n\ndef get_db():\n    db = SessionLocal()\n    try:\n        yield db\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\n@router.patch(\n    \"/api/volunteer-shifts/{shift_code}/cancel\",\n    operation_id=\"cancel_volunteer_shift_and_void_donation\",\n    response_model=CancelVolunteerShiftResponse,\n    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK\n)\nasync def cancel_volunteer_shift_and_void_donation(\n    shift_code: str,\n    cancellation_reason: str,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Find the shift by shift_code\n    shift = db.query(VolunteerShift).filter(VolunteerShift.shift_code == shift_code).first()\n    if not shift:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Volunteer shift not found\")\n\n    # Check if shift is already cancelled or completed\n    if shift.status in [\"cancelled\", \"completed\", \"no_show\"]:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=f\"Cannot cancel shift with status '{shift.status}'\")\n\n    # Update shift status\n    shift.status = \"cancelled\"\n    shift.cancellation_reason = cancellation_reason\n    shift.cancelled_at = datetime.utcnow()\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(shift)\n\n    # Try to find associated donation allocation\n    allocation = db.query(DonationAllocation).filter(DonationAllocation.volunteer_shift_id == shift.id).first()\n    donation_voided = False\n\n    if allocation:\n        # Void the donation allocation\n        allocation.status = \"voided\"\n        allocation.voided_at = datetime.utcnow()\n        db.commit()\n        db.refresh(allocation)\n        donation_voided = True\n\n    return CancelVolunteerShiftResponse(shift=shift, donation_voided=donation_voided)"
    },

      "path": "routers/group_002.py",
      "content": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy.orm import Session\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom database import SessionLocal\nfrom models import Donation, DonationAllocation\nfrom schemas import VoidDonationRequest, VoidDonationResponse\n\nrouter = APIRouter(tags=[\"Donations\"])\n\n\ndef get_db():\n    db = SessionLocal()\n    try:\n        yield db\n    finally:\n        db.close()\n\n\n@router.patch(\n    \"/api/donations/{donation_code}/void\",\n    operation_id=\"void_donation\",\n    response_model=VoidDonationResponse,\n    status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK\n)\nasync def void_donation(\n    donation_code: str,\n    payload: VoidDonationRequest,\n    db: Session = Depends(get_db)\n):\n    # Find the donation by donation_code\n    donation = db.query(Donation).filter(Donation.donation_code == donation_code).first()\n    if not donation:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=\"Donation not found\")\n\n    # Check if donation is already voided or completed\n    if donation.status in [\"voided\", \"refunded\", \"completed\"]:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=f\"Cannot void donation with status '{donation.status}'\")\n\n    # Find associated allocation\n    allocation = db.query(DonationAllocation).filter(DonationAllocation.donation_id == donation.id).first()\n    if not allocation:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=\"No associated allocation found for this donation\")\n\n    # Update donation\n    donation.status = \"voided\"\n    donation.void_reason = payload.void_reason\n    donation.voided_at = datetime.utcnow()\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(donation)\n\n    # Update allocation\n    allocation.status = \"voided\"\n    allocation.voided_at = datetime.utcnow()\n    db.commit()\n    db.refresh(allocation)\n\n    return VoidDonationResponse(donation=donation, allocation=allocation)"
    }
